errors.text_span: Auf der horizontalen Achse sind die Jahre in zweijährigen Abständen von 2000 bis 2024 angeordnet
errors.evidence: The labels on the x-axis are in two-year intervals, but there is a bar for every single year from 2000 to 2024, not just for the labeled years. The description incorrectly implies there are only bars for every two years.

The description interprets the horizontal line at 60% as the 'Maastricht criterion threshold'. While this is likely correct contextually, the chart itself does not provide this label, so it is an interpretation beyond what is explicitly shown.

errors.text_span: die genauen Werte sind über den Balken als Zahlen angegeben
errors.evidence: This statement claims that exact values are given as numbers above the bars for all the years listed. In reality, only four bars (for years 2010, 2018, 2021, and 2022) have numerical labels. The description fabricates this detail for the other years.
The values for these years are not all 60%. For example, the bar for 2000 is visibly below the 60% line, and the values fluctuate around 60% in the following years but are not identical.
The value 68.1 is explicitly labeled for the year 2021 in the chart, not 2012. The bar for 2012 is much higher, at approximately 80%.
The value 62.9 is explicitly labeled for the year 2022 in the chart, not 2014. The bar for 2014 is much higher, at approximately 74%.
The value 68.1 corresponds to the year 2021, not 2020. The bar for 2020 is slightly lower than the one for 2021.
The value for 2024 is not 62.9; that value corresponds to the year 2022. The bar for 2024 is visibly lower, closer to the 60% line, and has no numerical label.

The description incorrectly states that no bars are visually highlighted. The bars for the years 2023 and 2024 are rendered in a lighter shade of blue than all the other bars, which is a form of visual distinction that has been missed.
